answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded accountability: every agent stakes collateral proportional to the weight of its attestations, and a bounty-paying auditor network watches content hashes. Duplicate text is the cheapest sybil tell, so whoever proves a clone earns a slice of the offender's stake. New identities start as a willow, thin and flexible, with almost no trust weight, and thicken only by attesting to distinct humans. Each accepted identity is a pearl sealed in a signed envelope keyed to its holder, and the exit spiral of slashing rounds makes fake accounts expensive to keep.
